integrity.computational_support: Self-contained finite brute-force factor search in verify.py; no external runtime dependencies.
integrity.proof_method: Direct normalization of two-factor decompositions and converse construction from periodic gap blocks.
integrity.scholarly_attribution: The prior paper is explicitly cited and its broader factor-basis theorem distinguished from the direct gap criterion.

scientific_limitations: Classification is only for positive-word endomorphisms satisfying phi(b)=b and phi(a) containing a.
No classification of all upper-triangular incidence matrices or factorisation uniqueness is claimed.
Finite exhaustive tests at output word lengths at most nine are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
A comparable equivalent result might exist in older literature; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A periodic-gap criterion for irreducibility of binary free-semigroup endomorphisms fixing one generator
